contract_gaps_and_source_mismatches.finding: Stored viewport bypass hides actual page and input-state differences at four exact content widths.
Current live sample omits gzip(true), present in both frozen and design source.

Current editor builder unconditionally sets TabBehavior::Leave; frozen default option is tab_leaves off, which leaves the component default Indent. Current component indent default is 2, frozen page builds editor with indent 4 unless option overrides.

Current page constructs only a 12-row editor and does not set fill_height, while the shared component exposes fill-height measurement; frozen composition gives the editor pane 26 rows of page height and sizes against the measured side pane.

Current EditorPage does not compose or handle Run button/action/tick/diagnostic lifecycle. It advertises Ctrl+R in hints, but CodeAction/CodeCmd have no run event and Page implementation does not override command. Candidate State Props hard-code run/cursor/diagnostic values.

Current page's completion items are three fixed keywords; frozen demo uses ranked candidates including functions/types/macros, replaces the preceding word and varies presentation options. The library already supplies typed provider/batch/completion APIs, so migrate semantic candidate data and use the shared completion component rather than static reference rows.

Find key handling belongs to CodeEditor, but the frozen Find button routes a user action into opening the same editor-owned find state. CodeCmd::Find exists but dispatch is internal; no public typed request to open Find from a sibling Button is evidenced. Add that narrow shared adapter/API, then let Button emit activation and CodeEditor own focus/query/cursor.

Frozen Options and States views are absent from the current page implementation. Shared Tabs and stateful CodeEditor/Props adapters exist, but the current page does not use them. Several baseline CodeEditor settings (Esc revert, per-editor command/navigation/text keymaps, horizontal/scrollbar policies) lack corresponding CodeEditor builder fields in the inspected public API; preserve only after demonstrating consumer-backed options.

Current classifier maps true/false through KEYWORDS; frozen classifier has a separate LITERALS role. Termrock SyntaxRole has Constant, so use language-role mapping that preserves the separate semantic token/style. No source evidence says frame parity is already attained.

Composition provides code editor and PropsList leaves but no Panel adapter was found; Panel currently requires the app page to call draw with manually allocated Rect. Add the shared panel leaf/slot or another public composition contract before replacing the raw split/paint layout; keep geometry in shared resolver.

minimal_staged_replacement_owner.work: Rebuild the actual page before removing the bypass. Keep CodeEditorState the sole owner of text/edit/find/scroll/selection/cursor/diagnostics. Do not clone or paint code cells.

Add a public typed open-find request path from Button activation into CodeEditor-owned find state; add any required panel/composition leaf and semantic cursor-position accessor. Preserve Run as a Showcase demo-domain action: shared Button emits activation, demo model owns countdown/run result, CodeEditor accepts running range/diagnostics through public state API.
